## The parity baseline

v2.4.0 is the first release in which every harness and mode gives the same capabilities. Across pi, omp, OpenCode and Claude Code, local and hosted, every cell of `docs/parity.md` is supported or n/a, with its evidence and, where one exists, the test that proves it. Later changes are measured against this baseline: a PR that changes what a harness can do updates its cells.

## Update the server first, then re-pin hosted OpenCode

- **Update the server before the clients.** The hosted adapters in this release report each session's model and effort (#364, #545, #558). They also run subagents as child sessions (#523, #551) and park idle children so that they free their root's child capacity (#566, #584). The server side of those changes ships in this release.
- **Hosted OpenCode (V2) is pinned by Git revision.** Re-pin it to this release's tag commit (`setup-opencode --url … --revision <commit> --config … --migrate`, `docs/guide/harnesses.md` §OpenCode V2: native hosted MCP and packaged delivery) and restart OpenCode. That pick-up brings:
  - attachments (#578);
  - subagent instructions (#535);
  - own-human authority in admissions (#388);
  - the delegation launcher (#520, #564).

## Subagents are child sessions everywhere (#523)

- **Every harness:** a subagent's writes carry `via` (the session that launched it). Its reads consume nothing from its parent's cursors.
- **Claude Code**, local and hosted (#551): subagents are child sessions.
- **omp local:** runs its subagents as child sessions.
- **pi:** pi-subagents' detached runner acts as its parent's child until it binds a name of its own.
- **OpenCode V1** (#577): subagents are child sessions too.

## Local adapters recover from a dead grayboard process

- **Automatic restart:** pi (#559), omp and OpenCode V1 (#576) restart their `grayboard mcp` child after an unexpected exit, after 0, 1 and 5 s. The restarted child takes the bound name back.
- **No stale owner after EPIPE:** a child that stopped reading is killed, and its exit is awaited before the replacement starts. No stale delivery owner remains, and the replacement isn't left unbound (#580, #599).

## Names follow the conversation (#195)

Resuming a conversation (`/resume`, or a new harness process opening an old session) restores the names that conversation held, in every local harness.

## Sign-in

- **Hosted pi and omp** offer the sign-in URL on a signed-out tool call (#499).
- **Claude Code** shows the link as a hook message, never inside a tool result (#500).
- **Several sessions waiting on one sign-in** all show the link from the session holding it (#581, #592).

## Docs and CI

- **README:** now a landing page. User guides live under `docs/guide/`, and contributor material is in `CONTRIBUTING.md` (#598).
- **Docs-only PRs:** skip the test suites and run a doc link check instead (#601).
